value.rationale: The 3x3 torus is the first simple four-regular square ice with both directions genuinely periodic, and 148 is its classical unsigned count. The exact 16-level multivariate signed character spectrum gives 31744 additional even-weight zeros, a sharp restricted inverse bound 1/4 and unrestricted endpoint constant 445/64, providing a meaningful new finite recovery benchmark for signed six-vertex systems rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
